evals.prompt: 다음 자료로 괴담 스레드 만들어줘. 자료: 한 달째 매일 새벽 3시 33분에 현관 벨이 울리는데, 카메라에는 아무도 찍히지 않는다.
expected_behaviors: Delivers a standalone HTML file built from assets/viewer.html with white-background light styling.
Posts number sequentially from 1, post 1 opens the report, and every anchor points to an existing post.
「悪魔情報」 appears in fixed kanji as the story leader: late entrance greeted by regulars, drives the investigation, shakes the thread once with a conspiracy tangent.
Named voices keep consistent speech quirks; anonymous posters carry no demographic descriptors.

evals.prompt: Turn this into a thread story: scientists repeated fusion ignition three times this year with growing net energy yield, latest shot doubled the gain.
expected_behaviors: Completes a full arc using freshly invented recurring characters built on the leader formula (specialty + drive + one flaw).
Article facts keep their original claims; dramatization attaches around them.
Output renders through the light-theme template with gapless numbering.

evals.prompt: 어젯밤 옥상에서 하얀 인형 같은 사람이 웃고 있었다는 글이 실시간 검색에 올랐다는 설정으로, 1시간 이상 분량의 스레드 만들어줘.
expected_behaviors: Applies the time-expression mapping: targets 1000+ posts and states a staged continuation plan when one response cannot hold the scale.
Keeps occult/horror casting intact across the plan, including 「悪魔情報」 leadership.

evals.prompt: Use this cooking-fail blog post as material for a thread story. Post: tried mirror-glaze cake at 2am, glaze slid off onto the cat, smoke alarm agreed with the cat.
expected_behaviors: Proceeds straight to production without asking about length; sizes the thread to the material's arc.
Infers comedic slice-of-life genre from tone and notes the inference at delivery.
A short single-scene thread counts as valid output here.
